summary: Read an allowed string of distinct lowercase letters and a list of words. The allowed string has length from 1 to 26, the list holds from 1 to 104 words, and each word has length from 1 to 10. Every character is a lowercase English letter. A word qualifies when each of its characters also occurs inside the allowed string. Count the qualifying words and write that count.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
